adjudicated_statement: Over C with Q-coefficients, let Hbar^bal=[H^bal/PGL_2] be the balanced degree-four genus-six Hurwitz stack. Balancedness is required only on the nonempty open of general simply-branched covers supplied by the Bujokas-Patel theorem, not on every simply-branched cover. Using the ordered simple-branch chart over M_0,18, its classical finite-etale branch morphism, the connected finite-etale triple cover C -> M_0,4 obtained from y^3=x(x-1) after deleting the three branch points, and the induced finite-etale refinement of the corresponding open in M_0,18, there exists a connected reduced separated finite-type scheme V with an etale morphism V -> Hbar^bal such that Gr^{15,1} Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;C) is nonzero. The localization step uses that every removed scheme has dimension at most 14 and, via Deligne's relative compact-support mixed Hodge construction, F^15 H_c^16 of such a scheme vanishes; strictness of morphisms of mixed Hodge structures and finite-etale pullback/trace then preserve a nonzero class of type (15,1). Consequently Gr^W_16 H_c^16(V;Q) is not a direct sum of Q(-8). If U -> Hbar^bal is any reduced separated finite-type etale surjective scheme atlas, then U disjoint-union V is another allowed atlas and its compactly supported cohomology contains this non-Tate direct summand. Thus any condition (H-S) universally requiring Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) to be a sum of Q(-8) for every such scheme atlas S is false at j=8. This statement concerns cohomology of chosen scheme atlases only: FND-0167 does not assert (H-S), and no conclusion follows about Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q), T_Z, RED-0001, or stack-level compact-support cohomology.
contradiction_resolution: ATT-0118 and REV-0166 were checked at the exact passages supporting this finding. They do not contradict one another: REV-0166 confirms the Kummer-cover, Kunneth, localization, finite-etale trace, and atlas-adjunction argument in ATT-0118. Both establish only failure of the universally quantified base-atlas condition (H-S) at j=8; neither establishes non-Tate cohomology of Z or T_Z. The apparent theorem-level conflict is resolved by scope: ATT-0118 refuted a v4 formulation that included (H-S), whereas the current v5 C66-TATE-SUPPORT target is the canonical subquotient T_Z and FND-0167 does not itself assert (H-S). The injection recorded in FND-0167 cannot transport non-Tate-ness from S upward to Z, and the relevant complement for Z has dimension 16, so the F^15-vanishing used for 14-dimensional complements is unavailable there. Primary-source checking also requires two wording repairs. First, Bujokas-Patel proves balancedness for a general cover when g >= (d-3)(d-1); for (d,g)=(4,6) this supplies a nonempty balanced open, not balancedness of every simply-branched cover and not by itself a stack statement. Second, Deligne's Theorem 8.2.4 is stated for ordinary cohomology; the compact-support bound used here is obtained through the relative/support formulation in section 8.3.10(c), after a proper compactification of the same dimension. It gives p <= dim(Y), hence F^15 H_c^16(Y)=0 when dim(Y) <= 14. These corrections leave the counterexample intact. FND-0173 should not be promoted separately because the v5 packet already contains the same corrected result as corroborated FND-0169, together with the necessary Z-nontransport caveat in FND-0171. It is therefore merged into FND-0169 rather than retained or retired as false.
